speaker: charlie
text: Thanks Sam! Now in sports, this week kicks off something really special - National Volunteer Week from May 18th to 24th. The Australian Sports Commission is calling on everyone to give three cheers for the volunteers who power our sporting communities.

speaker: alice
text: And they absolutely deserve those cheers! These are the legends running the canteen, coaching the kids, marking the lines, and making sure every weekend warrior gets their game on. Without them, grassroots sport in Australia would simply not exist.

speaker: charlie
text: Too right Jamie. Whether it's your local footy club, tennis club, or cricket association, there's always someone there early setting up and staying late to pack down. This week's all about putting these community champions on the map where they belong.
